description: Agent configurations compared by run. Every arm uses the same agent, model and CLI arguments; arms differ only in the fields shown.

baseline.description: No TokenSave: no MCP servers, unindexed checkout.

tokensave.description: TokenSave MCP server (libSQL) on an indexed checkout; server instructions only.

tokensave-guided.description: As tokensave, plus the rules text `tokensave install` writes for Claude Code, appended to the system prompt. Tests whether guidance changes tool use.

caveman.description: No TokenSave; the pinned Caveman skill passed with --caveman-skill, appended to the system prompt (#797).

tokensave-caveman-nocoop.description: As caveman, plus the TokenSave MCP server with Caveman cooperation off. Measures TokenSave's effect while Caveman is on.

tokensave-caveman.description: As tokensave-caveman-nocoop, with Caveman cooperation on: the server finds the pinned skill and adds its cooperation paragraph. Measures that paragraph's effect.
